llm.evidence: Samples were analysed by LC-MS/MS on a Q-Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer
Modulation of cell signaling following inhibitor treatment was quantified using global phosphoproteomics and stable isotope labelling by amino acids in cell culture (SILAC)
seven SCX fractions were phospho-peptide enriched using titanium dioxide beads
The Q Exactive was run in DDA-MS2 top10 method
1 mM Dithiothritol was then added to this mixture
Chloroacetamide was then added at 1 in 100 dilution
